title: Hay lazawaal deher me
body:
Hay lazawaal deher me
(Tayree wafa ghazee hay baqa ghazee) x2
(Hay lazawaal dahar main tayree wafa ghazee) x2
<<MINI>>
Fana nehi jisay markay hay wo baqa ghazi
Tayree wafa ghazee...
<<DIVIDER>>
Faqat muheet nehi kerbala pay iski wafa
Qadam qadam pay hua moula par fida ghazi
<<MINI>>
Tayree wafa ghazee...
<<DIVIDER>>
Labay furat say zahra ki arahee thi sada
Tu mayri baitee ka wahid tha asira ghazi
<<MINI>>
Tayree wafa ghazee...
<<DIVIDER>>
Khayamay alay aba main hua hay hashr bapa
Ali kay laal say jis dam hua juda ghazi
<<MINI>>
Tayree wafa ghazee...
<<DIVIDER>>
Rahi Hay dair talak bazoo chumti Zainab
Ummulbanin ko jim dam hua ata ghazi
<<MINI>>
Tayree wafa ghazee...
<<DIVIDER>>
Ameer iska badal koee nehi zamanay main
Jahan mein mulkay wafa ka hay kibriya ghazi
<<MINI>>
Tayree wafa ghazee...
Fana nehi jisay markay hay wo baqa ghazi
